name: Inkline Text Editor
soft_passes: #2 pair balances around optical centre but composition is bottom-weighted by the aurora ribbons; neither stroke individually centred
#3 silhouette is clean and distinctive but abstract — not instantly nameable as a concrete subject; the text-editor/caret reading needs the name to unlock
failures: #10 variant robustness: whole read depends on the dark ground (white caret needs black to pop, diagonal glow is a dark-mode bloom); glass effects are baked into a flat 512px PNG, so light/clear/tinted behaviour is undemonstrated and looks fragile

palette.background: ramp #271F44->#030512 (indigo top edges to near-black bottom-centre; centre #0B0D22)

light_model: emissive glass in the dark — single coherent model: lit top edge (#2F274C) + violet right-rim specular (#5D3C9B), a self-illuminating diagonal stroke that blooms onto the field, and emissive aurora ribbons at the base; no competing sun direction
layer_stack: emissive aurora ribbons + sparkle dust (bottom third)
purple->blue diagonal slash with background glow bloom
glass edge specular (lit top edge + violet right rim), composited front
devices: caret + ink-stroke pairing (calm vertical white caret beside a kinetic tilted glowing slash — a literal 'Ink + line' rebus that states the subject)
emissive gradient stroke that lights its own field (glyph is a light source, not a painted shape)
aurora ribbons + sparkle dust at the base (refraction-under-glass scene grounding)
nocturnal glass field (near-black indigo ground inverting the Big-Sur white-field default)
rhymes_hint: dark-glass dev-tool / AI-app icon family — near-black or deep-indigo ground + one electric purple->blue emissive accent stroke, glass edge specular, no white field (Warp / Raycast-dark / Linear-mark energy). Candidate 'nocturnal-glass electric-accent' icon cluster; first member in corpus, needs >=2 more before canon
notes: 512x512 measured = half the 1024 master, a resized web render. Corners fully transparent (alpha 0): squircle is PRE-MASKED into the export, so raw Icon Composer full-bleed layers cannot be inspected. Glass effects (edge specular, glow bloom, emissive ribbons) are baked into the flat PNG — cannot confirm system-composited vs hand-baked, which is exactly what undermines #10. Palette hex reliable (clean PNG, no compression banding). HIG note: Apple says don't bake specular/glow/shadow into app-icon layers (system applies them) — if these are hand-baked this is an era deviation; if it's just an Icon Composer render preview it's fine, unverifiable from one flat PNG. Subject-communication is genuinely good for a dev tool: vertical white bar = text insertion caret, diagonal = inked line, together = 'Inkline'. Strong brand coherence with cover art (same indigo->black ground, same purple->blue accent, same aurora base-line, same 'V/' mark) — this is a designed identity system, not a lone icon.
